Which shortwave stations broadcast in Japanese?

In the A-26 schedule, 16 stations broadcast in Japanese. The most heavily scheduled include NHK Radio Japan, Shiokaze, China Radio International, Furusato no Kaze.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Japanese?

The most-used frequencies are 6055, 7325, 6115, 6070, 6155 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
